brute.idea: Linear scan for the target.

optimal.idea: Halve the range: compare mid to target, move low/high accordingly.

brute.idea: Linear scan for the first index with arr[i] >= x.

optimal.idea: Binary search: on arr[mid]>=x save mid and go left, else go right.

brute.idea: Linear scan for the first index with arr[i] > x.

optimal.idea: Binary search: on arr[mid]>x save mid and go left, else go right.

brute.idea: Linear scan for the first index with arr[i] >= target.

optimal.idea: Lower bound of the target; that index is where it would be inserted.

brute.idea: Linear scan tracking the last element <= x (floor) / first >= x (ceil).

optimal.idea: Binary search: floor = last element <= x (go right on arr[mid]<=x); ceil is the mirror.

brute.idea: Linear scan recording the first and last index of the target.

optimal.idea: Two binary searches: lower bound of target = first, upper bound - 1 = last.

brute.idea: Linear scan counting matches.

optimal.idea: count = upperBound(x) - lowerBound(x) via two binary searches.

brute.idea: Linear scan for the target.

optimal.idea: At each mid one half is sorted; check if target lies within it to pick a side.

brute.idea: Linear scan for the target.

optimal.idea: Like I, but when arr[low]==arr[mid]==arr[high] shrink both ends by one (duplicates).

brute.idea: Scan for the smallest element.

optimal.idea: If arr[mid] > arr[high], min is right of mid; else at mid or left.

brute.idea: Scan for the index of the minimum element.

optimal.idea: Index of the minimum element = number of rotations (binary search for the min).

brute.idea: XOR all elements, or scan checking pairs.

optimal.idea: Pairs align at even indices before the single; use index parity at mid to pick the side.

brute.idea: Scan for any element greater than both neighbors.

optimal.idea: If arr[mid] < arr[mid+1] a peak lies right, else at mid or left; move toward the higher side.

brute.idea: Iterate i from 1 while i*i <= n.

optimal.idea: Binary search x in [1,n]; largest x with x*x <= n.
Binary search the base; compare base^n to m, careful with overflow.

brute.idea: Try every speed from 1 upward until hours <= h.

optimal.idea: Binary search the speed; feasible(speed) = total hours <= h is monotonic.

brute.idea: Try every day from min to max bloom, check feasibility each time.

optimal.idea: Binary search the day; feasible(day) = enough adjacent bloomed flowers for m bouquets.

brute.idea: Try each divisor from 1 up, compute the sum of ceilings.

optimal.idea: Binary search the divisor; sum of ceil(a/divisor) <= threshold is monotonic.

brute.idea: Try every capacity from max weight up to the total sum, check days each time.

optimal.idea: Binary search capacity in [max weight, sum]; feasible(cap) = days needed <= D.

brute.idea: Walk the array counting missing numbers until you reach k.

optimal.idea: Missing before index i = arr[i]-(i+1); binary search where this reaches k.

brute.idea: Sort; try every possible gap from 1 upward, checking placement feasibility.

optimal.idea: Sort; binary search the minimum gap; feasible(gap) = can place all cows greedily.

brute.idea: Try every page limit from max-book to total sum, check students needed each time.

optimal.idea: Binary search the max pages per student; feasible = students needed <= k.

brute.idea: Try every candidate max sum from max-element to total, check splits each time.

optimal.idea: Binary search the largest allowed subarray sum; feasible = splits needed <= k.

brute.idea: Try every candidate max time from max-board to total, check painters each time.

optimal.idea: Binary search max time per painter; feasible = painters <= k (same as book allocation).

brute.idea: Repeatedly place each new station in the currently largest gap (max-heap), k times.

optimal.idea: Binary search the answer distance (reals); feasible = stations to add <= k.

brute.idea: Merge both arrays and take the middle.

better.idea: Merge just up to the median index without storing (count with two pointers).

optimal.idea: Binary search the partition of the smaller array so left half sizes/values balance.

brute.idea: Merge until the kth element is reached.

optimal.idea: Binary search the partition so exactly k elements sit on the left side.

brute.idea: Count 1s in every row and take the max.

optimal.idea: Each row sorted; binary search the first 1 per row, track the best row.

brute.idea: Scan every cell for the target.

better.idea: Find the candidate row (last with first element <= target), then binary search that row.

optimal.idea: Treat the fully-sorted matrix as one array: row = mid/cols, col = mid%cols.

brute.idea: Scan every cell.

optimal.idea: Start at top-right; go left if too big, down if too small.

brute.idea: Scan every cell checking it exceeds its four neighbors.

optimal.idea: Binary search columns; in the mid column find the row-max, compare horizontal neighbors.

brute.idea: Flatten all elements into one array, sort, take the middle.

optimal.idea: Binary search the value; count elements <= mid per row; median where count crosses (m*n)/2.
